newsitem.title: CHINA: Nokia in China mobile phone pact.
newsitem.headline: Nokia in China mobile phone pact.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy signed an agreement to expand the digital switching capacity for mobile telephones in eastern China, the Xinhua news agency said.

A Nokia joint venture, Beijing Nokia, and Zhejiang Posts and Telecommunications Administration agreed to expand the switching capacity of Zhejiang province's global system for mobile communications network to 280,000 channels, Xinhua said in a report filed late on Sunday.
It did not give details of current capacity and it gave no value for the contract.
Nokia would provide its DX200 switching platform, base station controllers and network management systems, it quoted the journal "China Telecomworld" as saying.
There were about 4.57 million mobile telephone users in China as of April, of which about 10 percent used digital mobile telephones, state media have said.
